set.body:
Owner: Intaglio core guide layout and public renderer contracts. Reproduced while reviewing the native ScalaFIM response-basis recipe, which calls the ordinary Intaglio plot DSL, PlotCompiler.resolve with GuidePolicy.Derived, and SVG/JavaFX renderers. This is a general guide sizing problem, not an application-specific fit or basis issue.

Evidence uses Intaglio revision 38e8c62b5b3fb74d0a32664a168e95e9f708bd49. The inspected derivative-window SVG has four legend circles at x=642.6667 and y=41.3333,60,78.6667,97.3333, each with radius 13.3333. Adjacent circles overlap by approximately 8 device pixels; the JavaFX screenshot shows the same overlap. Native recipe explicitly uses 8-point legend text, while LayoutPolicy's default legendKeyPt remains 10. The guide should budget the rendered glyph extent or reject an infeasible layout rather than let keys overlap. Inspect the radius/diameter interpretation before deciding the general repair; smaller marker styles may be appropriate but do not establish valid default guide geometry.

Artifacts: /private/tmp/plsneuro-basis-native-5/work/basis/derivative-window.svg, /private/tmp/plsneuro-basis-native-5/work/basis/02-derivative-window.png, /private/tmp/plsneuro-basis-legend-default-overlap.json. The full source recipe and frozen runtime provenance are retained by PLS Neuro W3 bd-01M1YVQ44TVRBAY11F30K7BTA1; durable receipt will be docs/verification/first-level-workbench-w3-basis.json.gz in that repository. Native ScalaFIM capability is bd-01M20FMAKKRF0AHAAKV3DD8V7C in its own store. These foreign IDs are provenance only.

Acceptance: reduce to an Intaglio-only public consumer; cover default and explicit marker/text sizes and glyph extents at multiple dimensions/DPI; verify non-overlapping key/label/title geometry through independent SVG bounds and native renderer evidence, plus relevant JVM/Scala.js core/layout gates. Preserve declared marker semantics and layout resource limits. The basis recipe is separately choosing compact 3-point keys and matching 8-point layout/text metrics as its intended style; that bounded configuration does not close this general issue.
set.title: Derived legend layout overlaps default point keys in resolved SVG and JavaFX scenes
